changelog:
Initial release of the master-curriculum skill for sequenced Buddhist learning paths.

- Provides stage-by-stage learning plans for major Buddhist traditions, based on user intent and input.
- Decision logic prioritizes explicit tradition requests, keyword matching, or fallback handling if no path exists.
- Uses a unified output template specifying texts to study, suggested masters, key concepts, pitfalls, and further resources.
- Enforces source and master verification for all references and recommendations.
- Distinct from /compare-masters (parallel comparison) and /master-debate (debate), focusing strictly on sequential curriculum planning.
summary: Use when user asks for a sequenced learning path within a Buddhist tradition — 学修次第, 先学什么, 从哪入门, 下一步读什么, curriculum, 学习计划, 路径推荐. Differs from /compare-masters (parallel opinion) and /master-debate (adversarial dialectic) by being 纵向 / 时序: stage-by-stage plan keyed on tradition × level (L0-L3) → foundation → intermediate → advanced + blind spots. Trigger is planning intent — "禅宗对比" goes to /compare-masters; "禅宗从哪开始学" goes here.
